exclusion_rule: a target is excluded if it is in coinco_dev_sub800 or coinco_test_sub800, if its sentence (CoInCo context) holds any target of either subset, or if its sentence is a SWORDS dev/test context (by CoInCo id or by text)

supersedes.reason: version 1 excluded the used 800-subset targets but not their sentences; 912 of its 2000 targets shared a sentence with an already-scored target.  No model was scored on it.
